name: lythosmsew
summary: Mechanically stabilised earth walls: external stability (sliding, overturning, eccentricity, bearing capacity by Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Hansen, Vesić and EN 1997-1), internal stability of steel strip and geosynthetic reinforcement (tensile, pullout, connection, sliding), corrosion and reduction factors, pseudo-static earthquake, ASD or LRFD, the required reinforcement length and a study over the wall height, with PDF reporting.
